Working entry: `Build directory held — the growth's cause measured, then mended; a working day's growth after the mend
stated as a number (v040-01)` (chk-zqcfusjv, Epoch 1 — Foundation of escher-0.4.0). The entry carries no freight
block (`block` view: 0 rows; `pins`: 0 rows).

- **A measurement of what grows `target/`.** Which cargo invocations of the dev host's ordinary work — the plan gate
  entries `gate.py run` fires, the CI legs `.github/scripts/ci-leg.sh` runs locally (`fast` and its parts, `a11y`,
  `stand-repeat`, `embolden`, `coverage`, `doc`, `build`), the agent-run harness `scripts/agent-run.sh`, the
  cold-agent pipe, and the dev-host-only mutation tier (cargo-mutants under nextest) — write which artifacts, and
  which edits mint a new metadata hash for which units. Read from a cold `target/` (it stands at 75 M after the
  overseer's `cargo clean`), each step's growth measured by size before and after, and each unit's hash read from
  cargo's own output (fingerprint / `--message-format` / the `deps/` names), not inferred.

- **The cause named** from that measurement: the share each mechanism carries — a re-hash per edit of a low crate, a
  feature set or package selection that differs between invocations and so builds the same test target under a
  second hash, a profile or flag difference, per-file integration-test binaries, debuginfo weight — each a number.

- **A mend** chosen from what the measurement names (the levers seen, none chosen: one test binary per leg in place
  of one per file; a sweep of stale hashes at a wrap or a boundary; less debuginfo for test binaries — or another the
  measurement points at), applied, with every check still green.

- **A working day's growth after the mend stated as a number** of gigabytes, read before and after on the dev host
  (matrix#v040-01, `method: manual`).
- No change to what any test asserts; a test moved or merged keeps its assertions and its two layout modes.

- The committed `Cargo.lock`, `--locked` on every build/test/CI leg, and the CI legs' membership stay as the
  invariants state; a change to a leg's cargo invocation is a CI-pipeline change pinned by
  `.github/scripts/test_ci_workflows.py` and `test_blitz_tests_targets.py` and goes through them.
- No new network, socket, env read or secret; a sweep touches `target/` alone.
- The mutation tier stays dev-host-only, never a CI leg.

- Duplication in the stand tests' setup is the separate entry «Stand-test setup shared» (chk-xxvbepua), not this one —
  unless the mend chosen (one binary per leg) moves those files anyway, which the plan then states.

body:
- **Cost:** not measurable here without building into the cold `target/` that implement's first measurement needs;
  the plan's measuring steps read each resolution's marginal disk bytes and wall-clock build time, in the order
  workspace → `-p blitz-tests` → `+font-embolden` → `-p seven_guis`, each after the ones before it (a unit two
  resolutions share is counted once, at the first), plus the units each resolution owns alone from cargo's JSON

- **workspace · `-p blitz-tests` — cannot be one.** `writing-mode` (workspace only) chooses which body of the bounds
  reader compiles, and each body holds a check of its own (test-plan `decision/bounds-reader-bodies-each-checked`);

- **`-p blitz-tests` · `+font-embolden` — cannot be one.** The feature is the embolden witness's subject (arch

- **`-p blitz-tests` · `-p seven_guis` — a candidate, not built.** `stand-repeat` runs them as two cargo lines; one

body:
- [inferred] cargo holds an exclusive file lock on the build directory, `target/debug/.cargo-lock`, for the length of
  a build («Blocking waiting for file lock on build directory» when a second cargo starts); a sweep that takes the
  same lock non-blocking before it removes anything therefore refuses while a build is in flight, and a build
  started while the sweep holds it waits. Unmeasured on cargo 1.99 — the plan's first sweep control reads it on the
  real tree (a sweep fired during the cold build must refuse).

- `scripts/target-sweep.py` — the stale-hash sweep: verbs `plan` and `run`, the keep set from cargo's JSON artifact lists over a closed selection list, removal confined to target/debug's deps, .fingerprint, build and incremental, under the build-directory lock

- `.github/scripts/test_target_sweep.py` — the sweep's contract under a cargo shim and a fake target directory, unittest, run by the ci-scripts leg

- **Marker:** 2026-11-19-build-directory-held · **Version:** escher-0.4.0 · **Generated:** 2026-11-19T08:51:48Z

Measure what grows `target/` and mend it. P3 has already measured part of the cause without building (research
§Patterns). Cargo mints a new unit hash only when a unit's resolved features, its dependencies' versions (the
lockfile), its profile or flags, or the rustc version change. A source edit rebuilds in place: a scratch probe on
cargo 1.99 added 0 files after an edit and a new hash after a feature flip. Today the engine builds under four
feature resolutions (workspace · `-p blitz-tests` · `+font-embolden` · `-p seven_guis`). `Cargo.lock` has changed
seven times since 2026-11-13, and cargo never collects a superseded hash. This chunk re-reads that cause on the
real tree and states each resolution's disk and build-time cost as a measurement only, with whether two of them
could be one (inputs#I2). It then builds the mend the operator chose, a stale-hash sweep (inputs#I2), and states
a replayed working day's growth with and without it as numbers (matrix#v040-01).

The sweep is a dev-host script on the Python standard library (arch standing S1; layouts S2). It keeps every unit
that a closed list of the project's own selections builds, read from cargo's own JSON artifact lists. It removes
the rest of `target/debug`'s `deps/`, `.fingerprint/`, `build/` and `incremental/` units, and touches no other
state under `target/` (arch `decision/run-state-areas-local-only`; obs `decision/agent-run-cleanup-scoped`,
`decision/cold-agent-cleanup-scoped`). It is safe while a build is in flight, or refuses then (inputs#I2): it takes
cargo's build-directory lock non-blocking before removing anything, and a unit written after its keep pass began
is kept. No check, leg, profile, manifest, lockfile or ratified decision moves. The two load-bearing builds stay
two (test-plan `decision/per-package-green-not-workspace-green`), and one target per file stays (test-plan
`decision/one-test-target-per-file`).

1. **The footprint instrument (chunk evidence, not committed).** Write
   `.andromeda/cache/chunks/2026-11-19-build-directory-held/evidence/footprint.py` on the stdlib. It has three verbs:
   - `step {label} -- {command…}` runs the command from the repository root and appends one JSON line to
     `…/evidence/footprint.ndjson`. The line holds the label, the command's exit, its wall-clock seconds,
     `du -sb target/debug` before and after (and of `target/` as a whole), the count of files in `target/debug/deps`,
     and the distinct-hash count per integration-test stem. A stem is one of the 184 `tests/blitz-tests/tests/*.rs`
     targets or the 8 `examples/seven_guis/tests/*.rs` targets, read from `target/debug/deps/{stem}-{16 hex}`
     executables.
   - `units {label} -- {cargo command with --message-format=json…}` records the set of artifact hashes cargo names
     for that selection.
   - `read {label}` records the sizes alone.

   It prints only its own JSON line; cargo's merged output goes to `…/evidence/{label}.log`. Nothing it writes holds
   a host path; the logs stay in the gitignored work dir (security `decision/agent-run-raw-log-unprinted`, by
   analogy).

2. **Cold cost of each resolution, with the first sweep control.** Assert `target/debug` is absent (research: `du -sh
   target` 75M with no `debug/`). Then fire through `footprint.py step` in this order, each with `--locked
   --no-run`:
   - `cold-workspace` — `cargo test --workspace`
   - `cold-blitz-tests` — `cargo test -p blitz-tests`
   - `cold-embolden` — `cargo test -p blitz-tests --features blitz-paint/font-embolden --test select_popup_painted`
   - `cold-seven-guis` — `cargo test -p seven_guis`

   Fire `footprint.py units` for the same four selections afterwards. Each resolution's marginal bytes and seconds
   are what it added after the ones before it; the units it owns alone come from the four artifact sets.

   **Control — refuse during a build:** once `target/debug` exists and `cold-workspace` is still compiling, fire
   `python3 scripts/target-sweep.py run` once by hand. It must print `refused: build-in-flight` and exit 3, and
   `target/debug/deps`' file count must be unchanged across it. This also measures the research lock premise: cargo
   1.99 holds `target/debug/.cargo-lock` for the length of a build. If it does not refuse, stop here and surface it:
   the sweep's safety rests on that equality. Record where `cargo llvm-cov` builds:
   `footprint.py step llvm-cov-env -- cargo llvm-cov show-env`, the target-directory line read.

3. **The hash mechanism on the real tree.** These are one-shot measurements, not gate entries; each restores what it
   changes, with sha256 compared before the next reading (testing session addition 2026-10-09).
   - **Edit.** Append one comment line to `packages/blitz-traits/src/lib.rs` (saved bytes first). Fire
     `edit-blitz-tests` (`cargo test -p blitz-tests --locked --no-run`) and record the new hashes against the step
     before. Predicted 0, from the scratch probe; record what the real tree measures. Restore the file and compare
     sha256.
   - **Lock move.** Choose one registry crate below blitz-dom that has an older version in the local cargo cache. Fire
     `cargo update --offline -p {crate} --precise {older}`, then `lock-blitz-tests` (`cargo test -p blitz-tests
     --locked --no-run`). Record the new hashes, predicted one per unit above the crate in that resolution. Restore
     with `git checkout -- Cargo.lock` and assert `git diff --quiet b9a3bb19a7145332d6e50567489d8d831db66379 --
     Cargo.lock`. A re-fire of `lock-restored` must add 0 hashes, because the old ones still stand.
   - **Cause line.** Write it from these readings, naming the share of distinct hashes per stem each mechanism
     carries: resolutions, lockfile epochs and the toolchain epoch (the `msrv` leg's 1.91 beside stable).

4. **The replayed working day, unmended.** From the warm state step 3 leaves, `read day-a-start`. Then fire through
   `footprint.py step`, in order, the day's mix taken from the gate-entry tally of the 27 chunks since 2026-11-13
   (research §Patterns):
   - `bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh fast`
   - `bash scripts/agent-run.sh boot`, `run stand`, `run session`
   - `bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh stand-repeat`
   - `cargo test -p escher-driver --locked`
   - `cargo test -p dioxus-native-dom --locked`
   - `bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh doc`
   - one lock move, made as in step 3, followed by `bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh fast`, then the lock restored
     (sha256 asserted)
   - `bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh fast` again

   Finish with `read day-a-end`. Every leg must read green; a red stops the replay and is surfaced, never retried.
   The unmended growth is `day-a-end − day-a-start`.

5. **The sweep — `scripts/target-sweep.py`** (new; stdlib; keeps arch S1, layouts S2, security S3, obs S1 and S5):
   - **Usage.** `python3 scripts/target-sweep.py {plan|run}`, run from the repository root. Any other argv prints one
     usage line on stderr and exits 2 before anything else runs. It reads no environment variable of its own and no
     secret.
   - **Refusals (exit 3, nothing removed).** Off unix it refuses with `refused: unsupported-host`. With no
     `target/debug` it refuses with `refused: no-build-directory`.
   - **Keep pass.** Record the pass's start time. Run, in order and each with `--locked --message-format=json`:
     - `cargo test --workspace --no-run` (legs `test`, `a11y`)
     - `cargo test -p blitz-tests --no-run` (`stand-repeat`, agent-run `boot` and `run`)
     - `cargo test -p blitz-tests --features blitz-paint/font-embolden --test select_popup_painted --no-run`
       (`embolden`)
     - `cargo test -p seven_guis --no-run` (`stand-repeat`, agent-run `run session`)
     - `cargo build -p seven_guis --bin escher-session` (the cold-agent pipe's precondition)
     - `cargo clippy --workspace` (clippy line 1)
     - `cargo clippy -p blitz-dom --no-default-features --features svg,woff,accessibility,system-fonts,file-input,custom-widget --all-targets` (clippy line 2)

     The keep set is every unit hash these runs name. A keep run that exits non-zero ends the sweep with exit 1 and
     nothing removed.
   - **Lock, then remove.** Take an exclusive non-blocking `flock` on `target/debug/.cargo-lock`. If it is held,
     print `refused: build-in-flight`, exit 3 and remove nothing. Holding the lock, take each unit of
     `target/debug/{deps,.fingerprint,build,incremental}` whose hash is outside the keep set and whose
     `.fingerprint/{name}-{hash}` directory was last modified before the keep pass's start. `plan` counts these
     units; `run` removes them. Then release the lock.
   - **Never touched.** `target/debug`'s top-level files (the `escher-session` binary among them),
     `target/{agent-run,cold-agent,tmp,ci-logs,coverage,doc,mutants-tmp,llvm-cov-target}`, any `target/mutants-*`,
     and anything outside `target/`.
   - **Stdout.** One JSON line encoded by `json`: `verb`, `units_kept`, `units_removed` (or `units_to_remove` under
     `plan`), `bytes_before`, `bytes_after`, `seconds`. It holds no path or name of a unit and no key of the
     scrub set (obs standing S1). Cargo's output goes to the keep pass's own discarded stream; nothing is logged.
   - **Exit.** 0 swept or planned · 1 a keep run failed · 2 usage · 3 refused.

6. **`scripts/target-sweep.ps1`** (new) — the Windows pass-through in `cold-agent.ps1`'s form (layouts S2): every
   argument passed unchanged to `python3 "$PSScriptRoot/target-sweep.py"`, its exit code returned. The sweep
   itself refuses off unix.

8. **The replayed working day, mended.** `python3 scripts/target-sweep.py run` (removing day A's superseded
   hashes), then `read day-b-start`. Replay step 4's mix again, end with `python3 scripts/target-sweep.py run`
   through `footprint.py step day-b-sweep`, then `read day-b-end`. The mended growth is `day-b-end − day-b-start`.
   **Control — safe after a sweep:** fire the keep pass's four `cargo test … --no-run` selections and `cargo build -p
   seven_guis --bin escher-session` once more through `footprint.py step warm-after-sweep`. Each log must hold no
   `Compiling` line: the sweep removed no live unit, and the cold-agent binary still stands.

9. **The footprint report.** Write `.andromeda/cache/chunks/2026-11-19-build-directory-held/evidence/footprint-report.md`
   from `footprint.ndjson` as column-0 lines, each the number with its source label beside it:
   - `cause: …`
   - `resolution workspace: …`, `resolution blitz-tests: …`, `resolution embolden: …`, `resolution seven-guis: …` —
     each with marginal GB, seconds and units owned alone
   - `could-be-one: …` — research's four judgements, with the measured shared units of `-p blitz-tests` and
     `-p seven_guis`
   - `edit: …`, `lock-move: …`
   - `llvm-cov: …`
   - `day-unmended: …`, `day-mended: …` — each in GB, read by `du -sb` before and after
   - `control-refuse: …`, `control-warm: …`

   Land the work dir: `python3 -X utf8 ~/.claude/skills/andromeda-tools/scripts/rec.py land --root . --chunk
   2026-11-19-build-directory-held`.
- `scripts/target-sweep.py` — the stale-hash sweep (step 5)
- `scripts/target-sweep.ps1` — its Windows pass-through (step 6)
- `.github/scripts/test_target_sweep.py` — its contract under a cargo shim (step 7)
- none

No boot-path is touched (no binary, stand or app source changes), so there is no smoke entry. The measuring steps
2–4 and 8 and the hash mechanism's one-shot edit and lock move are implement's steps outside this block. Each
writes `.andromeda/cache/chunks/2026-11-19-build-directory-held/evidence/footprint.ndjson` and `footprint-report.md`,
which entry 5 reads without producing them. The two sweep controls are those steps' readings (steps 2 and 8),
beside the unit test's two lock cases. The diff adds a unix-only refusal (a runtime platform test), so the plan
carries the operator's hygiene, push and CI entries.

body: - **External inputs:** `inputs#I1` — the operator's directive: the overseer's 773 GB / 193 binaries / 30–65 stale hashes read is a hypothesis to re-measure, the cause measured first, the levers none chosen, a stop at P5 · `inputs#I2` — the operator's P4 answers: the mend a stale-hash sweep, the working day a replayed one; the four resolutions' disk and build-time cost stated as a measurement with whether two could be one, no unification built; the sweep safe while a build is in flight or refusing then, a control for each · `inputs#I3` — the operator's P5 review: the sweep's one owning caller is `ci-leg.sh fast`, after a green verdict on a dev host, skipped when `CI` is set, never reddening the leg, its JSON line printed; replayed day B ends on `fast`

- `.github/scripts/test_ci_workflows.py` (289-299, 395-409) — `run_leg` drives the real `ci-leg.sh` from a temp dir under a `cargo` shim on `PATH`; `test_fast_leg_ends_on_the_font_embolden_witness` runs `fast` with a `python3` shim exiting 0 and reads the embolden log — a sweep call through `python3` after the loop meets that shim and leaves the pin green
- `.github/scripts/ci-leg.sh` — the `fast` arm runs `scripts/target-sweep.py run` after its legs read green, skipped when `CI` is set, its exit discarded
- **Marker:** 2026-11-19-build-directory-held · **Version:** escher-0.4.0 · **Generated:** 2026-11-19T09:00:34Z

Measure what grows `target/` and mend it. P3 has already measured part of the cause without building (research
§Patterns). Cargo mints a new unit hash only when a unit's resolved features, its dependencies' versions (the
lockfile), its profile or flags, or the rustc version change. A source edit rebuilds in place: a scratch probe on
cargo 1.99 added 0 files after an edit and a new hash after a feature flip. Today the engine builds under four
feature resolutions (workspace · `-p blitz-tests` · `+font-embolden` · `-p seven_guis`). `Cargo.lock` has changed
seven times since 2026-11-13, and cargo never collects a superseded hash. This chunk re-reads that cause on the
real tree and states each resolution's disk and build-time cost as a measurement only, with whether two of them
could be one (inputs#I2). It then builds the mend the operator chose, a stale-hash sweep (inputs#I2), with one
owning caller: the local pre-push gate (inputs#I3). It states a replayed working day's growth with and without
the sweep as numbers (matrix#v040-01).

The sweep is a dev-host script on the Python standard library (arch standing S1; layouts S2). It keeps every unit
that a closed list of the project's own selections builds, read from cargo's own JSON artifact lists. It removes
the rest of `target/debug`'s `deps/`, `.fingerprint/`, `build/` and `incremental/` units, and touches no other
state under `target/` (arch `decision/run-state-areas-local-only`; obs `decision/agent-run-cleanup-scoped`,
`decision/cold-agent-cleanup-scoped`). It is safe while a build is in flight, or refuses then (inputs#I2): it takes
cargo's build-directory lock non-blocking before removing anything, and a unit written after its keep pass began
is kept.

Its one caller is `bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh fast` (inputs#I3), the local pre-push gate (arch
`decision/local-pre-push-gate`). After the five fast legs read green, it runs the sweep as its last step on a dev
host. It skips the sweep when `CI` is set, and its exit stays the legs' verdict, so a sweep refusal or failure
never reddens the leg; the sweep's one JSON line is printed. No CI job, other leg, profile, manifest, lockfile or
ratified decision moves. The two load-bearing builds stay two (test-plan
`decision/per-package-green-not-workspace-green`), and one target per file stays (test-plan
`decision/one-test-target-per-file`).

1. **The footprint instrument (chunk evidence, not committed).** Write
   `.andromeda/cache/chunks/2026-11-19-build-directory-held/evidence/footprint.py` on the stdlib. It has three verbs:
   - `step {label} -- {command…}` runs the command from the repository root and appends one JSON line to
     `…/evidence/footprint.ndjson`. The line holds the label, the command's exit, its wall-clock seconds,
     `du -sb target/debug` before and after (and of `target/` as a whole), the count of files in `target/debug/deps`,
     and the distinct-hash count per integration-test stem. A stem is one of the 184 `tests/blitz-tests/tests/*.rs`
     targets or the 8 `examples/seven_guis/tests/*.rs` targets, read from `target/debug/deps/{stem}-{16 hex}`
     executables.
   - `units {label} -- {cargo command with --message-format=json…}` records the set of artifact hashes cargo names
     for that selection.
   - `read {label}` records the sizes alone.

   It prints only its own JSON line; the command's merged output goes to `…/evidence/{label}.log`. Nothing it writes
   holds a host path; the logs stay in the gitignored work dir (security `decision/agent-run-raw-log-unprinted`, by
   analogy).

2. **Cold cost of each resolution, with the first sweep control.** Assert `target/debug` is absent. If one of this
   chunk's own P5 baselines or gates built it first, remove `target/debug` alone: every unit in it is this chunk's
   own build, since `target/` was cold at the take-up (research: `du -sh target` 75M with no `debug/`). Then fire
   through `footprint.py step` in this order, each with `--locked --no-run`:
   - `cold-workspace` — `cargo test --workspace`
   - `cold-blitz-tests` — `cargo test -p blitz-tests`
   - `cold-embolden` — `cargo test -p blitz-tests --features blitz-paint/font-embolden --test select_popup_painted`
   - `cold-seven-guis` — `cargo test -p seven_guis`

   Fire `footprint.py units` for the same four selections afterwards. Each resolution's marginal bytes and seconds
   are what it added after the ones before it; the units it owns alone come from the four artifact sets.

   **Control — refuse during a build:** this step runs after step 5 has written the sweep, so implement writes step 5
   first. Once `target/debug` exists and `cold-workspace` is still compiling, fire `python3 scripts/target-sweep.py
   run` once by hand. It must print its JSON line with `"outcome": "refused"` and `"cause": "build-in-flight"` and
   exit 3, and `target/debug/deps`' file count must be unchanged across it. This also measures the research lock
   premise: cargo 1.99 holds `target/debug/.cargo-lock` for the length of a build. If it does not refuse, stop here
   and surface it: the sweep's safety rests on that equality. Record where `cargo llvm-cov` builds:
   `footprint.py step llvm-cov-env -- cargo llvm-cov show-env`, the target-directory line read.

4. **The replayed working day, unmended.** It runs on the tree before step 8 wires the sweep into `fast`, so no
   sweep runs in it. From the warm state step 3 leaves, `read day-a-start`. Then fire through `footprint.py step`,
   in order, the day's mix taken from the gate-entry tally of the 27 chunks since 2026-11-13 (research §Patterns):
   - `bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh fast`
   - `bash scripts/agent-run.sh boot`, `run stand`, `run session`
   - `bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh stand-repeat`
   - `cargo test -p escher-driver --locked`
   - `cargo test -p dioxus-native-dom --locked`
   - `bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh doc`
   - one lock move, made as in step 3, followed by `bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh fast`, then the lock restored
     (sha256 asserted)
   - `bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh fast` again

   Finish with `read day-a-end`. Every leg must read green; a red stops the replay and is surfaced, never retried.
   The unmended growth is `day-a-end − day-a-start`.

5. **The sweep — `scripts/target-sweep.py`** (new; stdlib; keeps arch S1, layouts S2, security S3, obs S1 and S5):
   - **Usage.** `python3 scripts/target-sweep.py {plan|run}`, run from the repository root. Any other argv prints one
     usage line on stderr and exits 2 before anything else runs, with no JSON line. It reads no environment variable
     of its own and no secret.
   - **One JSON line.** Every other ending prints exactly one JSON line on stdout, encoded by `json` with its default
     separators. It holds `verb` (`plan` or `run`) and `outcome` (`swept`, `planned`, `refused` or `failed`). A
     refusal or failure adds `cause` (`build-in-flight`, `no-build-directory`, `unsupported-host` or `keep-run`). A
     sweep or plan adds the counts `units_kept`, `units_removed` (or `units_to_remove` under `plan`),
     `bytes_before`, `bytes_after` and `seconds`. No path, unit name or scrub-set key appears (obs standing S1).
     Cargo's output goes to a discarded stream; nothing is logged.
   - **Refusals (exit 3, nothing removed).** Off unix the cause is `unsupported-host`; with no `target/debug` it is
     `no-build-directory`.
   - **Keep pass.** Record the pass's start time. Run, in order and each with `--locked --message-format=json`:
     - `cargo test --workspace --no-run` (legs `test`, `a11y`)
     - `cargo test -p blitz-tests --no-run` (`stand-repeat`, agent-run `boot` and `run`)
     - `cargo test -p blitz-tests --features blitz-paint/font-embolden --test select_popup_painted --no-run`
       (`embolden`)
     - `cargo test -p seven_guis --no-run` (`stand-repeat`, agent-run `run session`)
     - `cargo build -p seven_guis --bin escher-session` (the cold-agent pipe's precondition)
     - `cargo clippy --workspace` (clippy line 1)
     - `cargo clippy -p blitz-dom --no-default-features --features svg,woff,accessibility,system-fonts,file-input,custom-widget --all-targets` (clippy line 2)

     The keep set is every unit hash these runs name. A keep run that exits non-zero ends the sweep with `"outcome":
     "failed"`, `"cause": "keep-run"`, exit 1 and nothing removed.
   - **Lock, then remove.** Take an exclusive non-blocking `flock` on `target/debug/.cargo-lock`. If it is held, end
     with `"outcome": "refused"`, `"cause": "build-in-flight"`, exit 3 and nothing removed. Holding the lock, take
     each unit of `target/debug/{deps,.fingerprint,build,incremental}` whose hash is outside the keep set and whose
     `.fingerprint/{name}-{hash}` directory was last modified before the keep pass's start. `plan` counts these
     units; `run` removes them. Then release the lock.
   - **Never touched.** `target/debug`'s top-level files (the `escher-session` binary among them),
     `target/{agent-run,cold-agent,tmp,ci-logs,coverage,doc,mutants-tmp,llvm-cov-target}`, any `target/mutants-*`,
     and anything outside `target/`.
   - **Exit.** 0 swept or planned · 1 failed · 2 usage · 3 refused.

8. **The sweep wired into `fast` — `.github/scripts/ci-leg.sh`** (modified; inputs#I3).
   - **Placement.** The `fast` arm keeps its loop over `FAST_LEGS` unchanged, stopping at the first red with that
     leg's status as today (`set -e`), and `FAST_LEGS` keeps its five legs. When the loop ends green, the arm takes
     one more step before `exit 0`: when `CI` is unset or empty, it runs `python3
     "$SCRIPTS/../../scripts/target-sweep.py" run`, its stdout printed as is. The sweep's exit is discarded, so the
     arm's `exit 0` stands whatever the sweep reads.
   - **Pins kept.** No other leg changes; no `LEGS` entry is added; `test_ci_workflows.py`'s
     `test_fast_leg_ends_on_the_font_embolden_witness` keeps reading green.
   - **Why the `CI` guard.** GitHub Actions sets `CI=true` on every job, and ci.yml runs no `fast` job.
   - **Comment.** A comment above the step names it the dev host's owning call of the sweep.

9. **The replayed working day, mended.** It runs with step 8's wiring in place and fires no sweep by hand. Fire
   `bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh fast` through `footprint.py step day-b-open`; its sweep removes day A's
   superseded hashes. Then `read day-b-start`. Replay step 4's mix again: its last command is `fast` itself, whose
   sweep ends the day. Then `read day-b-end`. The mended growth is `day-b-end − day-b-start`.
   - **Fast cost.** Read from the `fast` steps' wall-clock and the sweep's `seconds` against day A's `fast` steps.
   - **Control — safe after a sweep.** Fire the keep pass's four `cargo test … --no-run` selections and `cargo build
     -p seven_guis --bin escher-session` once more through `footprint.py step warm-after-sweep`. Each log must hold
     no `Compiling` line: the sweep removed no live unit, and the cold-agent binary still stands.

10. **The footprint report.** Write `.andromeda/cache/chunks/2026-11-19-build-directory-held/evidence/footprint-report.md`
   from `footprint.ndjson` as column-0 lines, each the number with its source label beside it:
   - `cause: …`
   - `resolution workspace: …`, `resolution blitz-tests: …`, `resolution embolden: …`, `resolution seven-guis: …` —
     each with marginal GB, seconds and units owned alone
   - `could-be-one: …` — research's four judgements, with the measured shared units of `-p blitz-tests` and
     `-p seven_guis`
   - `edit: …`, `lock-move: …`
   - `llvm-cov: …`
   - `day-unmended: …`, `day-mended: …` — each in GB, read by `du -sb` before and after
   - `fast-sweep-cost: …` — the seconds the sweep adds to `fast`
   - `control-refuse: …`, `control-warm: …`

   Land the work dir: `python3 -X utf8 ~/.claude/skills/andromeda-tools/scripts/rec.py land --root . --chunk
   2026-11-19-build-directory-held`.
- `.github/scripts/test_target_sweep.py` — its contract and the fast leg's ownership of it, under shims (step 7)
- `.github/scripts/ci-leg.sh` — the `fast` arm runs the sweep after a green verdict on a dev host, skipped when `CI` is set, its exit discarded (step 8)
No boot-path is touched (no binary, stand or app source changes), so there is no smoke entry.

The P5 baselines' 101 GB build (this chunk's own; `target/` was 75 M at take-up) was renamed to `target/p5-baseline-debug`, outside every `target/debug` reading and a constant inside the whole-`target` ones. body:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Step 2's control: fire the sweep's run while the cold workspace build holds target/debug, from the repository
root. Prints one JSON line: the sweep's own line, its exit, and target/debug/deps' names before and after."""

import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[5]
deps = ROOT / "target/debug/deps"
log = (ROOT / "target/debug/../../.andromeda/cache/chunks/2026-11-19-build-directory-held/evidence/cold-workspace.log")
if not deps.is_dir():
    print(json.dumps({"precondition": "no target/debug/deps"}))
    sys.exit(1)
compiling = "Compiling" in log.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") if log.exists() else False
before = set(p.name for p in deps.iterdir())
proc = subprocess.run(["python3", "scripts/target-sweep.py", "run"], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True,
                      timeout=7200)
after = set(p.name for p in deps.iterdir())
print(json.dumps({
    "ts": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
    "build_log_compiling": compiling,
    "sweep_stdout": proc.stdout.strip(),
    "sweep_exit": proc.returncode,
    "deps_before": len(before),
    "deps_after": len(after),
    "deps_removed": len(before - after),
    "removed_names_shape": sorted({__import__("re").sub(r"[0-9a-f]{16}","H",n) for n in before - after}),
}))

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# The replayed working day (steps 4 and 9), from the repository root: `bash day.sh a` or `bash day.sh b`.
# Every command runs through footprint.py step; the first non-zero exit stops the day, never retried.
set -u
day="$1"
E=.andromeda/cache/chunks/2026-11-19-build-directory-held/evidence
F=$E/footprint.py
LOCKSAVE=$E/Cargo.lock.day-$day.saved
n=0
step() {
    n=$((n + 1))
    local label="day-$day-$(printf '%02d' "$n")-$1"
    shift
    python3 "$F" step "$label" -- "$@"
    local code
    code=$(tail -n 1 "$E/footprint.ndjson" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.loads(sys.stdin.read())["exit"])')
    if [ "$code" != 0 ]; then
        echo "day $day stopped: $label exit $code"
        exit 1
    fi
}

python3 "$F" read "day-$day-start"
step fast bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh fast
step agent-boot bash scripts/agent-run.sh boot
step agent-stand bash scripts/agent-run.sh run stand
step agent-session bash scripts/agent-run.sh run session
step stand-repeat bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh stand-repeat
step escher-driver cargo test -p escher-driver --locked
step dioxus-native-dom cargo test -p dioxus-native-dom --locked
step doc bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh doc
cp Cargo.lock "$LOCKSAVE"
want=$(sha256sum < Cargo.lock)
cargo update --offline -p memchr --precise 2.8.2 > "$E/day-$day-lock-move.log" 2>&1
step lock-fast bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh fast
cp "$LOCKSAVE" Cargo.lock
got=$(sha256sum < Cargo.lock)
if [ "$want" = "$got" ] && git diff --quiet b9a3bb19a7145332d6e50567489d8d831db66379 -- Cargo.lock; then
    echo "day $day lock restored: sha256 equal, equals base"
else
    echo "day $day lock NOT restored"
    exit 1
fi
step fast-again bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh fast
python3 "$F" read "day-$day-end"
echo "day $day done"

title: evidence/footprint.py
body:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Footprint instrument for 2026-11-19-build-directory-held (chunk evidence, not committed).

  step {label} -- {command...}    run the command from the repository root, sizes before and after
  units {label} -- {cargo ... --message-format=json}   record the unit hashes cargo names
  read {label}                    sizes alone

Appends one JSON line to footprint.ndjson beside this file and prints only that line; the command's merged output
goes to {label}.log beside it.
"""

import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[4]
LEDGER = HERE / "footprint.ndjson"
HASH = re.compile(r"-([0-9a-f]{16})(?:\.|$)")


def du(rel):
    path = ROOT / rel
    if not path.exists():
        return 0
    out = subprocess.run(["du", "-sb", str(path)], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    return int(out.split()[0]) if out else 0


def stems():
    names = [p.stem for p in (ROOT / "tests/blitz-tests/tests").glob("*.rs") if p.stem != "all"]
    names += [p.stem for p in (ROOT / "examples/seven_guis/tests").glob("*.rs")]
    return sorted(set(names))


def sizes():
    deps = ROOT / "target/debug/deps"
    files = list(deps.iterdir()) if deps.is_dir() else []
    per_stem = {}
    wanted = set(stems())
    for f in files:
        m = re.match(r"^(.+)-([0-9a-f]{16})$", f.name)
        if m and m.group(1) in wanted and f.is_file():
            per_stem.setdefault(m.group(1), set()).add(m.group(2))
    counts = {s: len(per_stem.get(s, ())) for s in sorted(wanted)}
    values = list(counts.values())
    return {
        "debug_bytes": du("target/debug"),
        "target_bytes": du("target"),
        "deps_files": len(files),
        "stems": len(values),
        "stem_hashes_total": sum(values),
        "stem_hashes_max": max(values) if values else 0,
        "stem_hashes_min": min(values) if values else 0,
        "stem_hashes": counts,
    }


def append(line):
    with LEDGER.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(line) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in line.items() if k not in ("stem_hashes", "before", "after", "hashes")}
                     | {"after_debug_bytes": line.get("after", {}).get("debug_bytes")}))


def main(argv):
    if len(argv) < 2 or argv[0] not in ("step", "units", "read"):
        print(__doc__, file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    verb, label = argv[0], argv[1]
    ts = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())
    if verb == "read":
        s = sizes()
        append({"verb": "read", "label": label, "ts": ts, "after": s})
        return 0
    if len(argv) < 4 or argv[2] != "--":
        print(__doc__, file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    command = argv[3:]
    log = HERE / f"{label}.log"
    before = sizes() if verb == "step" else None
    t0 = time.monotonic()
    if verb == "step":
        with log.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
            code = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, stdout=out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).returncode
        seconds = round(time.monotonic() - t0, 2)
        after = sizes()
        append({"verb": "step", "label": label, "ts": ts, "exit": code, "seconds": seconds, "before": before,
                "after": after, "delta_debug_bytes": after["debug_bytes"] - before["debug_bytes"],
                "delta_target_bytes": after["target_bytes"] - before["target_bytes"]})
        return 0
    proc = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
    log.write_text(proc.stderr, encoding="utf-8")
    hashes = set()
    for raw in proc.stdout.splitlines():
        try:
            msg = json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if not isinstance(msg, dict):
            continue
        names = []
        if msg.get("reason") == "compiler-artifact":
            names = [n for f in msg.get("filenames") or [] for n in (Path(f).name, Path(f).parent.name)]
        elif msg.get("reason") == "build-script-executed" and msg.get("out_dir"):
            names = [Path(msg["out_dir"]).parent.name]
        hashes.update(m.group(1) for n in names if (m := HASH.search(n)))
    append({"verb": "units", "label": label, "ts": ts, "exit": proc.returncode,
            "seconds": round(time.monotonic() - t0, 2), "units": len(hashes), "hashes": sorted(hashes)})
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Step 3's lock move (smallvec 1.16.1 refused offline by parley's ^1.16.2, Cargo.lock left unchanged): memchr
# 2.8.3 -> 2.8.2, restored and its sha256 compared, then the restored lock re-read.
set -eu
E=.andromeda/cache/chunks/2026-11-19-build-directory-held/evidence
F=$E/footprint.py
LOCKSAVE=$E/Cargo.lock.saved
cp Cargo.lock "$LOCKSAVE"
lockwant=$(sha256sum < Cargo.lock)
cargo update --offline -p memchr --precise 2.8.2 > "$E/lock-move-update.log" 2>&1
git diff --stat -- Cargo.lock
python3 "$F" step lock-blitz-tests -- cargo test -p blitz-tests --locked --no-run
cp "$LOCKSAVE" Cargo.lock
lockgot=$(sha256sum < Cargo.lock)
[ "$lockwant" = "$lockgot" ] && echo "lock restored: sha256 equal"
git diff --quiet b9a3bb19a7145332d6e50567489d8d831db66379 -- Cargo.lock && echo "lock equals base"
python3 "$F" step lock-restored -- cargo test -p blitz-tests --locked --no-run

title: evidence/warm3.sh
body:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# The warm control on the final sweep (after the build-script and example fixes): one sweep, then the keep pass's
# four test selections and the escher-session build, from the repository root.
set -u
E=.andromeda/cache/chunks/2026-11-19-build-directory-held/evidence
F=$E/footprint.py
python3 "$F" step sweep-final -- python3 scripts/target-sweep.py run
cat "$E/sweep-final.log"
find target/debug/deps target/debug/build target/debug/.fingerprint -maxdepth 1 | sort > "$E/warm3-before.txt"
python3 "$F" step warm-after-sweep-3 -- bash -c '
set -e
cargo test --workspace --locked --no-run
cargo test -p blitz-tests --locked --no-run
cargo test -p blitz-tests --features blitz-paint/font-embolden --test select_popup_painted --locked --no-run
cargo test -p seven_guis --locked --no-run
cargo build -p seven_guis --bin escher-session --locked
test -x target/debug/escher-session && echo "escher-session stands"'
find target/debug/deps target/debug/build target/debug/.fingerprint -maxdepth 1 | sort > "$E/warm3-after.txt"
echo "warm compiling lines: $(grep -c Compiling "$E/warm-after-sweep-3.log")"
grep Compiling "$E/warm-after-sweep-3.log" | sed 's/ (.*//' | sort | uniq -c
echo "unit entries new after warm: $(comm -13 "$E/warm3-before.txt" "$E/warm3-after.txt" | wc -l)"
grep -c 'escher-session stands' "$E/warm-after-sweep-3.log"

title: evidence/why-warm.sh
body:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Diagnose the warm control's in-place rebuilds: a sweep, then the workspace selection with cargo's dirty reasons.
set -u
E=.andromeda/cache/chunks/2026-11-19-build-directory-held/evidence
find target/debug/deps target/debug/build target/debug/.fingerprint -maxdepth 1 | sort > "$E/why2-before-sweep.txt"
python3 scripts/target-sweep.py run
find target/debug/deps target/debug/build target/debug/.fingerprint -maxdepth 1 | sort > "$E/why2-after-sweep.txt"
echo "entries removed by sweep: $(comm -23 "$E/why2-before-sweep.txt" "$E/why2-after-sweep.txt" | wc -l)"
CARGO_LOG=cargo::core::compiler::fingerprint=info cargo test --workspace --locked --no-run > "$E/why2-dirty.log" 2>&1
echo "workspace after sweep exit $? compiling $(grep -c '  Compiling' "$E/why2-dirty.log")"
find target/debug/deps target/debug/build target/debug/.fingerprint -maxdepth 1 | sort > "$E/why2-after-ws.txt"
echo "entries new after workspace: $(comm -13 "$E/why2-after-sweep.txt" "$E/why2-after-ws.txt" | wc -l)"
comm -13 "$E/why2-after-sweep.txt" "$E/why2-after-ws.txt" | head -5
